plugins.name: dsh-shared-session
plugins.description: Share a live session with teammates: the host's model and tools do all the work, guests watch in real time and queue prompts; guest-triggered writes/shell/network require host approval. Includes a zero-dependency self-hostable relay.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把当前 ZCode 会话共享给团队:主机执行一切,客人实时旁观并注入 prompt,写操作需主机审批,含零依赖自建 relay。
